title: From T. rex to Chickens: Evolution Explained
description:
Have you ever eaten dinosaur tikka? You might think not—but if you’ve eaten chicken, you actually have. Modern birds are not just descended from dinosaurs, they are dinosaurs. The next time you eat chicken curry, biryani, or tikka masala, you’re technically eating a dinosaur. Surprised? Let’s break down the science.

In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we trace the incredible evolutionary journey from theropod dinosaurs like T. rex to the chickens and pigeons you see today. We explore fossils like Archaeopteryx, Sinosauropteryx, Vegavis, and the famous “wonderchicken” (Asteriornis), which reveal how feathers, hollow bones, and wishbones slowly transformed predators into birds. We also dive into genetics and development, showing how features like beaks evolved through small changes over millions of years.

If you’ve searched for “are chickens dinosaurs, birds evolved from dinosaurs, dinosaur to bird evolution, archaeopteryx explained, are birds reptiles”, then this video gives you the scientific perspective. Instead of myths from pop culture, we look at real fossil evidence, paleontology, and developmental biology to explain why calling birds “living dinosaurs” is not just catchy—it’s accurate.

Every pigeon on your balcony, every crow on a tree, and every chicken on your plate is living proof of evolution. Respect the humble chicken—it survived the asteroid impact that wiped out T. rex. Don’t forget to like, comment, share, and subscribe for more myth-busting, science-backed videos.

#Dinosaurs #BirdsAreDinosaurs #EvolutionExplained #PaleBlueThoughts #sciencevsmyth
